breve: A container that arranges its child controls horizontally or vertically.
descricao: A container that arranges its child controls horizontally or vertically, rearranging them automatically when their minimum size changes.

metodos.desc: Adds a Control node to the box as a spacer. If 'begin' is true, it will insert the Control node in front of all other children.

propriedades.desc: The alignment of the container's children (must be one of 'ALIGNMENT_BEGIN', 'ALIGNMENT_CENTER', or 'ALIGNMENT_END').

If true, the BoxContainer will arrange its children vertically, rather than horizontally.
Can't be changed when using HBoxContainer and VBoxContainer.

constantes.desc: The child controls will be arranged at the beginning of the container, i.e. top if orientation is vertical, left if orientation is horizontal (right for RTL layout).
The child controls will be centered in the container.
The child controls will be arranged at the end of the container, i.e. bottom if orientation is vertical, right if orientation is horizontal (left for RTL layout).

itens_tema.desc: The space between the BoxContainer's elements, in pixels.
